purpose: Override evidence metadata for existing misconception records after targeted empirical review. This file changes evidence status/source attribution only; it does not replace the underlying instructional description.

overrides.note: Operational-versus-relational equal-sign reasoning is directly supported in a Grades 3-5 study. Do not infer prevalence in a jurisdiction or treat one MathBridge item as validated.

Whole-number digit-length interference in decimal comparison is directly supported, but the verified school-age sample is Grade 7 rather than primary; use as a possible mechanism, not a primary prevalence claim.
Empirical studies document difficulty distinguishing area/perimeter and confusion between their formulae. Samples are local and do not establish universal prevalence.
Grades 3-6 research directly documents inappropriate additive reasoning on proportional problems. Not every ratio error should be classified this way.
The study supports broader variation in children's bar-graph interpretation, not the exact scale-assumed-one error. Keep the exact claim cautious.
Teaching guidance supports broader multiplicative representations, but direct empirical support for the exact internal wording has not yet been verified.
Keep as a useful probe; direct evidence for the exact internal-zero placeholder pattern remains pending.

resolver_rule: After resolving misconception aliases, merge an override by canonical misconception_id. resolved_status and evidence_level supersede the catalog's evidence metadata; source IDs are appended and deduplicated.
